title: allophylus mutabilis
intro: Allophylus mutabilis, commonly known as the changeable or variable tree, is a plant species in the family Sapindaceae, native to the tropical forests of Africa. The leaves, bark, and roots of the plant have been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, rheumatism, and digestive problems, due to its health benefits such as anti-inflammatory, antibacterial, and antifungal properties. The therapeutic actions of Allophylus mutabilis include its ability to reduce pain, lower fever, and combat infections, making it a valuable resource in traditional medicine. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
